name: nyme.sh (LongTurbo, slot 14)

mqtt.advice: Optional: turn on OK to MQTT to show your node on their map and chat.

notes: nyme.sh runs more than one network. Their homepage says the main network is moving to a non-default frequency slot; check their Discord for which one is active near you.
Intervals are minimums ('or longer'). Telemetry off for personal nodes.
LongTurbo became the firmware default in Meshtastic 2.8. A legacy LongFast network on slot 20 also still exists.
